prophet_vs_baseline.note: Positive improvement means Prophet's fleet-mean WAPE across the rolling backtest folds is lower than the best baseline's. A negative value is reported as-is -- it means the baseline measurably won on this data.

replenishment_backtest_ewma.methodology: 18 evaluation point(s), every 10 days across the last 180 days, each recomputed with ingredient_forecast()'s own `now` parameter using only data that existed at that point, checked against real ledger balances 7 days later.

false_alarm_breakdown.note: 'resolved_by_restock': a real purchase_receipt ledger row landed for that exact ingredient within the check window -- the flag's own lead-time logic is what that window is keyed to, so this is at least as consistent with the warning having been acted on as with it being wrong. 'genuine': no such receiving event occurred, yet the ingredient never actually hit zero -- the model overestimated risk with no restocking to explain why.

observable_windows.note: Same as `confusion`, but skips evaluation points whose 7-day check window recorded under 25% of a normal week's orders (a data-collection gap or closure). With no trading, no stock outcome can have been driven by demand, so a flag there is neither confirmed nor refuted. `confusion` above still includes them.

within_window_label.note: Stockout = balance <= 0 at any point inside the check window (what the docstring has always claimed), instead of only at its end. Same flags, same forecasts.

any_warning.note: Positive = critical, out OR at_risk, against the same end-of-window label. at_risk means 'depletes after the lead time but within lead + review cycle' -- ordering today still prevents it, so it is not part of the primary flag.

replenishment_backtest_ewma.adjusted_precision_note: Excludes false_alarm_breakdown.resolved_by_restock from the false-alarm count -- see that field's note. critical_flag_precision above is kept unchanged alongside this for comparison.

synthetic_stock_loss_rng.methodology: Synthetic stock-loss ledger rows generated in an isolated, throwaway database (never the production database), scaled against REAL ingredient on-hand levels and REAL average daily sale_commit consumption rates read from the live database read-only. The REAL, unmodified detect_anomalies() -> sample_for_review() -> submit_validation_label() -> scientific_validation_metrics() pipeline is then run against that database, with this harness submitting its own known ground truth as the 'human' label for every sampled record.

anomaly_injection_rules.large_fraction_of_on_hand: magnitude = on_hand_base * Uniform(0.35, 0.7) -- also exercises the real RULE_FRACTION_THRESHOLD=0.25 rule layer
anomaly_injection_rules.relative_magnitude_spike: magnitude = (on_hand_base * 0.035, the normal population's own on-hand-cap midpoint) * Uniform(8.0, 18.0) -- targets the relative_mag feature IsolationForest trains on

scientific_validation_metrics.methodology: Sample-based validation metrics, not a population census: the flagged population is reviewed up to its cap, but near-threshold and random-unflagged rows were SAMPLED rather than exhaustively reviewed. These figures describe the reviewed cohort under this model/eligibility version and must not be quoted as population-wide accuracy.

synthetic_consumption_rng.methodology: Synthetic unli_reconciliation rows generated in an isolated, throwaway database (never the production database) for the real 'wings' stream, scaled against the REAL baseline lambda coefficient and REAL bootstrap-sampled daily head counts read from the live database read-only. The REAL, unmodified detect_consumption_anomalies() -> sample_consumption_for_review() -> submit_consumption_validation_label() -> scientific_consumption_validation_metrics() pipeline is then run against that database, with this harness submitting its own known ground truth as the 'human' label for every sampled record.

scientific_consumption_validation_metric.methodology: Sample-based validation metrics, not a population census: the flagged population is reviewed up to its cap, but near-threshold and random-unflagged days were SAMPLED rather than exhaustively reviewed. These figures describe the reviewed cohort under this model/eligibility version and must not be quoted as population-wide accuracy.

synthetic_stock_loss_workbook.methodology: Wastage Log + Stock Counts + Receiving Log rows from the inventory workbook replayed into an isolated, throwaway database (never production) against REAL ingredient reference rows copied read-only from the live database. Ground truth is the workbook's own 'Injected Synthetic Truth' column, read directly.

default_thresholds.description: detect_anomalies() as shipped: rule layer (fraction>=0.25) OR IsolationForest capped to the worst 10% of the pool.

calibrated.calibration_method: Chronological 60/40 split; decision threshold = the IsolationForest score cutoff maximizing F1 on the train fold only, applied unchanged to the test fold. ROC-AUC/PR-AUC computed on the test fold's continuous scores (threshold-free).

synthetic_flavor_workbook.methodology: Unli Reconciliation rows from the historical workbook replayed into an isolated, throwaway database (never production) against REAL unli_flavor/ingredient reference rows copied read-only from the live database. Ground truth is the workbook's own 'Injected Synthetic Truth' column, read directly.

default_thresholds.description: detect_flavor_consumption_anomalies() as shipped: rule layer (variance/leftover/share) OR IsolationForest capped to the worst 25% of the pool.

calibrated.calibration_method: Chronological 60/40 split; decision threshold = the IsolationForest score cutoff maximizing F1 on the train fold only, applied unchanged to the test fold. ROC-AUC/PR-AUC computed on the test fold's continuous scores (threshold-free).

synthetic_consumption_workbook.methodology: Unli Reconciliation rows from the historical workbook aggregated per service_date (summed across all 14 flavours, a single shared base unit) into one day-level stream and replayed into an isolated, throwaway database. Ground truth: a day is anomalous if any flavour that day carried INJECTED_CONSUMPTION_ANOMALY.

calibrated.calibration_method: Chronological 60/40 split; decision threshold = the IsolationForest score cutoff maximizing F1 on the train fold only, applied unchanged to the test fold. ROC-AUC/PR-AUC computed on the test fold's continuous scores (threshold-free).

fpgrowth_expanding_window.methodology: Three nested expanding-window folds over the same real 365-day dataset (~180d train / next ~60d test, ~240d train / next ~60d test, ~300d train / remaining ~65d test), boundaries placed against real calendar dates present in the data. A pair is checked against every fold whose test window was not already part of the training data that first identified it. See this module's EXPANDING_FOLD_DEFS / stability-rule comment for the fixed validated_stable / unstable_failed / insufficient_evidence rule, decided before any fold was evaluated.
